document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your party struggles back the way they came, to reach Bernard. 
As you watch him flail, the current tosses him backward and his 
head is thrown against a pointed crag. You hear the sickening 
crack of impact and see the tiny blossom of blood in the water. 
He goes under, eyes wide, mouth hanging slack. As he sinks, 
the  body  is  carried  away.  Norman  urges  pursuit,  but  Sylvia 
meets your eyes and you both acknowledge the truth. It takes a 
moment for her to convince Norman.

To press on and enter the fissure, go to 125. To turn toward home, 
go to 54.
